files.source: Developed here from full-normalization walker of incoming witness_discharge and a new deterministic Name rule; root uniform triple codec.
Same triple codec and normalizer with prior equality-proof Name rule.

support_lineage: tests/support/reference_old.py is inherited validation/reference_kernel.py from witness_discharge; reference_kernel.py changes Name to the deterministic first-row rule. macros.py changes packet row order, numerical case ordering and drops the equality proof. control_translations.py inherits the old separate-rule translation with imports redirected to reference_old. translate.py, packets.py, verify.py and measure.py are newly constructed untrusted utilities. The 13 source_proofs are verbatim inherited examples_four; 3 extra selected fixtures exercise both guard defaults and self-containing target erasure.
